# Tool Mart

> Tool Mart, Inc. is a family-owned industrial tool supplier founded in Houston, Texas in 1976. Factory-authorized dealer for RIDGID, Greenlee, Milwaukee and DeWALT; factory-authorized RIDGID and Greenlee repair center; daily/weekly/monthly equipment rental. Two stores: Houston (13721 S. Gessner Rd, Suite 200, Missouri City, TX 77489, +1-713-222-8665) and San Antonio (10568 Sentinel St, San Antonio, TX 78217, +1-210-655-6116). Hours Mon–Fri 7:30 AM–5:00 PM CT. Email info@toolmarthou.com.

## Shop
- [Pipe Threading & Plumbing](https://www.toolmarthou.com/collections/pipe-threading-tools): RIDGID® 1224, 535 & 300 threading machines, 700 power drives, 12-R manual sets, dies, oilers and TRISTAND® vises.
- [Cordless Power Tools](https://www.toolmarthou.com/collections/power-tools): Milwaukee® M18 FUEL™ and DeWALT® 20V MAX* drills, band saws, rotary hammers, grinders and combo kits.
- [Benders, Pullers & Knockouts](https://www.toolmarthou.com/collections/utility-electricians-tools): Greenlee® 555 and 1800 conduit benders, UT10 cable pullers, Slug-Buster® knockout sets and reel stands.
- [Press, Crimp & Cutting Tools](https://www.toolmarthou.com/collections/press-crimp-tools): Milwaukee® FORCE LOGIC™ press tools, 12-ton crimpers, cable cutters, jaws and die kits for utility and mechanical work.
- [Drain Cleaning & Inspection](https://www.toolmarthou.com/collections/drain-cleaning-inspection): RIDGID® drum and sectional drain machines, SeeSnake® camera reels and locators for service plumbers.
- [Hydraulic Tools](https://www.toolmarthou.com/collections/enerpac): Enerpac® cylinders, hand pumps, hydraulic punches, hoses and couplers for industrial maintenance.
- [Hand Tools & Measuring](https://www.toolmarthou.com/collections/general-purpose-hand-tools): Klein Tools®, Channellock®, Proto® and Starrett® — pliers, wrenches, tapes, levels and precision measuring.
- [Batteries, Dies & Accessories](https://www.toolmarthou.com/collections/parts-accessories): REDLITHIUM™ and 20V MAX* batteries, threading dies, blades, bits and OEM replacement parts.
- [Rental equipment](https://www.toolmarthou.com/collections/rentals): threaders, drain machines, cameras, press tools, benders — rates quoted per job.

## Brands (authorized dealer)
- [RIDGID](https://www.toolmarthou.com/collections/ridgid): Factory-authorized dealer & repair center
- [Milwaukee](https://www.toolmarthou.com/collections/milwaukee): Authorized dealer
- [Greenlee](https://www.toolmarthou.com/collections/greenlee): Authorized dealer & repair center
- [DeWALT](https://www.toolmarthou.com/collections/dewalt): Authorized dealer

## Services
- [Tool repair](https://www.toolmarthou.com/pages/toolmarts-repair): factory-authorized RIDGID & Greenlee repair with OEM parts; written quote after bench inspection; most repairs in a few business days.
- [Equipment rental](https://www.toolmarthou.com/pages/toolmarts-rental): daily, weekly, monthly; refundable deposit.
- [Request a quote](https://www.toolmarthou.com/pages/contact#quote): same-day quotes on the full manufacturer lines; contractor accounts with PO ordering.

## Policies
- Prices on the site are USD list prices; items over $2,000 and rentals are quoted.
- Rentals never display a $0 price; contact the store for rates.
